name: Harley-Davidson Servi-Car
engine: 45 cubic inch air-cooled side-valve V-twin, three wheels, rear axle
intro: Harley's three-wheel utility trike. The 45 flathead, a car-type rear axle and very long production.

E: It is a flathead. The valves sit beside the cylinder, so set the tappets with the engine cold and check the valve guides for wear.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
